item.title: Obituary: Elaine Maheux, 1938-2026
item.description: Elaine Maheux passed away on February 10, 2026, surrounded by her loving family. item.title: Vermont’s Ben Ogden and Paula Moltzan Win Olympic Medals
item.description: Ogden's silver ends the 50-year U.S. men's cross-country-skiing Olympic medal drought. In alpine skiing, Moltzan and Jacqueline Wiles teamed up to win bronze.
